problems: The polish-lithuanian-commonwealth dossier (eu-15) names zaporozhian-cossacks as the counterpart of its 1649-1654 vassal events; the Hetmanate page says the Hetmanate was officially the Zaporozhian Host. The two dossiers disagree on the 1651-1653 extent (Commonwealth: Kiev+Cherkasy; this dossier: the Zboriv extent).
tsardom-of-russia has a vassal_start for cossack-hetmanate (1654) with no vassal_end; the dossier schema has no way to write the vassal side from the Hetmanate.

The Ottoman occupation of the right bank 1672-1699 is written with ottoman-empire as the occupier-counterpart (as in the Tang example); the ottoman-empire dossier records Podolia as a gain/loss, not an occupation.

Murom, Yaroslavl, Zvenyhorod, Novgorod-Seversk and Great Perm overlap Cliopatria rows or sibling dossiers (Ryazan, Rostov-Suzdal, Vladimir-Suzdal, Chernigov, Novgorod); the renderer or a gap-filler must carve them.
Several of the 2-event dossiers are thin because the pages are stubs and give no area; every extent is a radius or oblast reading.
WebFetch returned some quotes as paraphrase; passages that were not verbatim are marked (page, paraphrased) or unquoted.
